fields.proposed_value: Discovery call on dealer visits and orders. Field reps visit about 200 dealers weekly and paper reports are typed into a spreadsheet, so nobody knows what dealers ordered or what reps promised. They want one place for 38 users, working offline with GPS check-in and linked to Orion ERP, with a budget of about USD 70,000 per year and go-live by July 2027. A field demo with two reps is set for 11 Nov.
